merged_issues.title: Missing or empty document title
merged_issues.description: The page does not include a non-empty <title> element in the document <head>. A descriptive title helps screen reader users understand the page context and improves navigation (e.g., between tabs/windows) and discoverability.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Add a meaningful, non-empty <title> in the <head>, e.g. <head><title>Page name – Site name</title>...</head>, and ensure it updates appropriately for each unique page/view.

merged_issues.title: Missing main landmark
merged_issues.description: The document does not have a main landmark region. A single <main> landmark helps assistive technology users quickly jump to the primary content of the page.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary page content in a single <main> element (or role="main"), ensure there is only one main landmark per page, and keep repeated navigation outside of it.

merged_issues.title: Bypass blocks mechanism not detected (needs review)
merged_issues.description: Automated checks could not confirm a mechanism to bypass repeated content (e.g., a skip link), and also indicated missing structural navigation aids (heading and/or landmark region). Users who rely on keyboards or assistive tech may have to tab through repeated navigation on every page.
merged_issues.recommended_fix:
Provide at least one bypass mechanism such as a visible-on-focus "Skip to main content" link targeting the main content container (e.g., Skip to main content and
...), and ensure the page has clear headings and landmark regions (header/nav/main/footer) to support navigation.
